title: Characterisation of a TatA/TatB binding site on the TatC component of the Escherichia coli twin arginine translocase
authors: Emmanuele Severi; Mariana Bunoro Batista; Adelie Lannoy; Phillip J. Stansfeld; Tracy Palmer
one_liner_zh: 该文通过诱变和分子动力学模拟研究大肠杆菌TatC上TatA/TatB结合位点，属于蛋白质-膜蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可借鉴于蛋白-DNA界面建模。
abstract: The twin arginine transport (Tat) pathway exports folded proteins across the cytoplasmic membranes of prokaryotes and the thylakoid membranes of chloroplasts. In Escherichia coli and other Gram-negative bacteria, the Tat machinery comprises TatA, TatB and TatC components. A Tat receptor complex, formed from all three proteins, binds Tat substrates, which triggers receptor organisation and recruitment of further TatA molecules to form the active Tat translocon. The polytopic membrane protein TatC forms the core of the Tat receptor and harbours two binding sites for the sequence-related TatA and TatB proteins. A ‘polar’ cluster binding site, formed by TatC transmembrane helices (TMH) 5 and 6 is occupied by TatB in the resting receptor and exchanges for TatA during receptor activation. The second binding site, lying further along TMH6 is occupied by TatA in the resting state, but its functional relevance is unclear. Here we have probed the role of this second binding site through a programme of random and targeted mutagenesis. Characterisation of three stably produced TatC variants, P221R, M222R and L225P, each of which is inactive for protein transport, demonstrated that the substitutions did not affect assembly of the Tat receptor. Moreover, the substitutions that we analysed did not abolish TatA or TatB binding to either binding site. Using targeted mutagenesis we introduced bulky substitutions into the TatA binding site. Molecular dynamics simulations and crosslinking analysis indicated that TatA binding at this site was substantially reduced by these amino acid changes, however TatC retrained function. While it is not clear whether TatA binding at the TMH6 site is essential for Tat activity, the isolation of inactivating substitutions indicate that this region of the protein has a critical function.
abstract_zh: 双精氨酸转运（Tat）途径将折叠蛋白输出穿过原核生物的细胞质膜和叶绿体的类囊体膜。在大肠杆菌及其他革兰氏阴性菌中，Tat机制由TatA、TatB和TatC组分构成。由这三种蛋白质形成的Tat受体复合物结合Tat底物，这触发受体组织化并招募更多TatA分子以形成活性Tat转位子。多拓扑膜蛋白TatC构成Tat受体的核心，并含有两个用于序列相关的TatA和TatB蛋白的结合位点。一个由TatC跨膜螺旋（TMH）5和6形成的“极性”簇结合位点在静息受体中被TatB占据，并在受体激活期间与TatA交换。第二个结合位点位于TMH6更远处，在静息状态下被TatA占据，但其功能相关性尚不清楚。在此，我们通过随机和定向诱变程序探讨了这第二个结合位点的作用。对三种稳定产生的TatC变体P221R、M222R和L225P的表征表明，这些替换并未影响Tat受体的组装，且每种变体在蛋白质运输中均无活性。此外，我们分析的替换并未消除TatA或TatB与任一结合位点的结合。通过定向诱变，我们将大体积替换引入TatA结合位点。分子动力学模拟和交联分析表明，这些氨基酸变化显著减少了TatA在该位点的结合，然而TatC保留了功能。尽管尚不清楚TatA在TMH6位点的结合是否对Tat活性至关重要，但失活替换的分离表明该蛋白质区域具有关键功能。
